name: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE
description:
Sign on to the MERIDIAN CORE credit-union servicing console using the given operator ID and password (select a branch if the sign-on screen asks for one), and reach the member-servicing home/menu screen. Confirm the signed-in operator's role is shown somewhere on the landing screen.

Returns: landing_screen — Name/title of the screen reached after sign-on (proves session is active).. Possible business outcomes: invalid_login.
